# A heartbeat check for irregular rhythms (generated by scripts/gate2.py)

8 s windows of the 16 development people as unseen people; thresholds per fold from the 2 tune people (95% of their real windows pass). Pass rates per person, then averaged.

## Fraction of windows that pass

| input          |   pass_periodicity |   pass_consistency |   pass_either |   pass_combined |
|:---------------|-------------------:|-------------------:|--------------:|----------------:|
| real           |              0.918 |              0.929 |         0.988 |           0.979 |
| white_noise    |              0     |              0.004 |         0.004 |           0.004 |
| pink_noise     |              0     |              0.058 |         0.058 |           0.058 |
| brown_noise    |              0     |              0.338 |         0.338 |           0.312 |
| shuffled_50ms  |              0.004 |              0.454 |         0.454 |           0.358 |
| shuffled_200ms |              0.004 |              0.742 |         0.746 |           0.512 |
